entity: India's severe food insecurity count derived from FAO's regional rows
what_we_add: The 2022-24 figure of 296.5M, 35% of FAO's world total, and the rise from 205.6M in 2014-16
why: Frontline ran the same subtraction on the same FAO rows and got 307.7M severe for 2019-21; the ISAS paper spells out the method. Same entity, same finding, earlier window; our 2022-24 number and world-share are new. The 2026 undernourishment-decline note is a different measure.
